# Vobiz CLI command reference

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-command-docs.mjs from the command tree. Do not edit; run `npm run docs:commands`. -->

Every command accepts the global options. Run `vobiz <command> --help` for the same information in your terminal.

## Global options

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `-V, --version` | print the CLI version |
| `--profile <name>` | saved login to use (env: VOBIZ_PROFILE) |
| `--auth-id <id>` | one-off Auth ID (env: VOBIZ_AUTH_ID) |
| `--auth-token <token>` | one-off Auth Token; lands in shell history (env: VOBIZ_AUTH_TOKEN) |
| `-o, --output <format>` | output format (env: VOBIZ_OUTPUT; default: table on a terminal, json when piped) (one of: `table`, `json`, `yaml`, `tsv`, `plain`, `jsonl`) |
| `--json` | shorthand for --output json |
| `--fields <paths>` | comma-separated fields to show (dot paths, e.g. id,meta.total) |
| `--query <path>` | print only this path of the output, after --fields (e.g. data[0].uuid, items[*].e164) |
| `-q, --quiet` | print only ids, one per line |
| `-y, --yes` | skip confirmation prompts; required for writes when stdin is not a terminal (env: VOBIZ_YES) |
| `--dry-run` | show the request (secrets redacted) and exit without sending |
| `--wait` | for calls and messages: wait until a final status |
| `--base-url <url>` | voice API base URL (env: VOBIZ_BASE_URL) |
| `--sms-base-url <url>` | Messaging API base URL (env: VOBIZ_SMS_BASE_URL) |
| `--timeout <seconds>` | per-request timeout in seconds (env: VOBIZ_TIMEOUT; default: 30) |
| `--no-color` | disable colors (env: NO_COLOR) |
| `--verbose` | log requests (method, route, status, duration) to stderr |
| `--debug` | also log request and response bodies, secrets redacted (env: VOBIZ_LOG=debug) |
| `--no-update-check` | skip the daily version check (env: VOBIZ_NO_UPDATE_CHECK, CI) |
| `-h, --help` | Display help for the command |

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Success. |
| 1 | Server error or unknown failure. |
| 2 | Usage error or invalid input. |
| 3 | Authentication failed, credentials missing, or access forbidden. |
| 4 | Not found. |
| 5 | Rate limited or insufficient balance. |
| 6 | Confirmation required (pass --yes) or the action is not allowed. |
| 7 | Outcome unknown: a side-effecting request timed out. Check the state before retrying. |
| 8 | Timeout or network error. |

### vobiz account

Account details, balance, concurrency, transactions and capacity

```
vobiz account <command> [options]
```

Subcommands: [`balance`](#vobiz-account-balance), [`channel-pricing`](#vobiz-account-channel-pricing), [`channel-subscriptions`](#vobiz-account-channel-subscriptions), [`concurrency`](#vobiz-account-concurrency), [`show`](#vobiz-account-show), [`transactions`](#vobiz-account-transactions)

### vobiz account balance

Show the account balance (in the pricing tier's currency unless --currency is given)

```
vobiz account balance [options]
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--currency <code>` | currency code, e.g. INR or USD |

### vobiz account channel-pricing

Preview the monthly price of CPS or concurrent-call capacity (nothing is charged)

```
vobiz account channel-pricing [options]
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--type <resource>` | capacity to price: concurrent_calls or cps (one of: `concurrent_calls`, `cps`) |
| `--quantity <n>` | capacity quantity (1-10000) |

### vobiz account channel-subscriptions

Recurring CPS or concurrent-call capacity

```
vobiz account channel-subscriptions <command> [options]
```

### vobiz api

Send a raw request to the Vobiz API, or list and describe every operation in the spec

```
vobiz api [method] [path] [options]
```

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `method` | no | HTTP method: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE |
| `path` | no | path relative to the API base, e.g. /api/v1/Account/{auth_id}/Call/ or /messages with --sms |

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--param <key=value>` | query-string parameter (repeatable) |
| `--body <json>` | JSON body, @file.json, or @- for stdin |
| `--sms` | send to the Messaging API (base https://api.vobiz.ai/api/v1/sms) |
| `--list` | list every operation in the spec |
| `--tag <tag>` | with --list: only operations with this tag (case-insensitive) |
| `--describe <operationId>` | show the parameters and body of one operation (sms:<id> or voice:<id> when ambiguous) |

### vobiz calls

Place, list, watch, hang up and control voice calls

```
vobiz calls <command> [options]
```

Subcommands: [`create`](#vobiz-calls-create), [`dtmf`](#vobiz-calls-dtmf), [`get`](#vobiz-calls-get), [`hangup`](#vobiz-calls-hangup), [`list`](#vobiz-calls-list), [`play`](#vobiz-calls-play), [`record`](#vobiz-calls-record), [`speak`](#vobiz-calls-speak), [`stream`](#vobiz-calls-stream), [`watch`](#vobiz-calls-watch)

### vobiz calls create

Place an outbound call (billed; asks for confirmation)

```
vobiz calls create [options]
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--to <dest>` | destination: E.164 number or SIP URI; join several with < to fan out (max 1000) |
| `--from <number>` | caller ID: a Vobiz number on this account, E.164 |
| `--answer-url <url>` | https URL that returns VobizXML when the call is answered |
| `--answer-method <method>` | HTTP method Vobiz uses for the answer URL (one of: `GET`, `POST`) |
| `--xml-file <path>` | answer with this VobizXML file (needs --serve or --xml-only) |
| `--say <text>` | answer by speaking this text (needs --serve or --xml-only) |
| `--voice <voice>` | with --say: voice, e.g. WOMAN or MAN |
| `--language <code>` | with --say: language, e.g. en-US |
| `--play <url>` | answer by playing this audio URL (needs --serve or --xml-only) |
| `--xml-only` | print the VobizXML for --say/--play/--xml-file and exit without calling |
| `--serve` | serve the XML from a local server for the call; requires --public-url (implies --wait) |
| `--port <port>` | with --serve: local port (default: 8787) |
| `--public-url <url>` | with --serve: the https URL your tunnel exposes for the local server |
| `--allow-insecure-url` | allow http:// (or ws://) URLs on localhost, for local testing |
| `--interval <seconds>` | seconds between status checks (default: 2) |
| `--max-wait <seconds>` | give up waiting after this many seconds (default: 600) |

Release a number (charges the release fee; cancellable for 24 hours unless --immediate)


|---|---|---|

|---|---|

Search the inventory for numbers you can buy, with their setup and monthly fees

|---|---|---|

Return a number to the main account's pool (refused during the 15-day cool-off after its last call)

|---|---|---|

|---|---|
| `--force` | admin accounts only: bypass the 15-day cool-off (audited) |

### vobiz numbers update

Link a number to an application or a SIP trunk, or unlink either (unlinks run first, so one command can switch)


|---|---|---|
| `e164` | yes | number on your account, in E.164 |

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--app <app-id>` | application whose answer URL handles inbound calls (see `vobiz apps list`); removes the number from its trunk first |
| `--unlink-app` | remove the number's application link |
| `--trunk <trunk-id>` | SIP trunk that receives inbound calls (see `vobiz trunks list`) |
| `--unlink-trunk` | remove the number from its SIP trunk |

### vobiz setup sms

```
vobiz setup sms [options]
```

| `--webhook-url <url>` | https URL for message.received, message.delivered and message.failed (reused if it exists) |
| `--webhook <id>` | use this existing messaging webhook instead |
| `--secret <secret>` | with --webhook-url: signing secret for X-Webhook-Signature |
| `--event <name>` | with --webhook-url: event to deliver (repeatable; default: the three message events) |
| `--no-webhook` | skip the webhook (you will poll message status instead) |

```

```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--number <e164>` | a number already on your account, e.g. +918065550100 |
| `--buy <e164>` | buy this inventory number first (see `vobiz numbers search`); shows the price before asking |
| `--country <code>` | interactive: search the inventory in this country (e.g. IN) instead of asking |
| `--contains <digits>` | interactive: only offer inventory numbers containing these digits |
| `--currency <code>` | with --buy: currency to bill in |
| `--trunk <trunk-id>` | SIP trunk that receives the number's calls (see `vobiz trunks list`) |
| `--app <app-id>` | link the number to this existing application (see `vobiz apps list`) |
| `--answer-url <url>` | create an application with this https answer URL and link the number to it |
| `--app-name <name>` | with --answer-url: name of the new application (default: Voice agent <number>) |
| `--answer-method <method>` | with --answer-url: HTTP method Vobiz uses for the answer URL (default: POST) (one of: `GET`, `POST`) |
| `--stream-url <wss-url>` | with --answer-url: the stream server the answer URL's <Stream> points at (added to the test plan) |

### vobiz sms send

Send a real, billed SMS, MMS or RCS message to one or more recipients

```
vobiz sms send [options]
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--from <sender>` | your Vobiz messaging number in E.164, or your RCS sender name for --type rcs |
| `--to <e164>` | recipient in E.164 (repeatable or comma-separated) |
| `--text <text>` | message body (required for sms and rcs) |
| `--text-file <path>` | read the message body from a file, or - for stdin |
| `--media-url <url>` | https URL of media to attach (repeatable; MMS up to 10, RCS sends the first) |
| `--type <channel>` | channel: sms (default), mms or rcs (one of: `sms`, `mms`, `rcs`) |
| `--title <subject>` | MMS subject line |
| `--tag <label>` | your label, stored on every message; filter `sms messages list --tag` by it |
| `--schedule-at <time>` | hold until this time: RFC 3339 (2026-11-01T09:00:00Z) or +30m, +2h, +1d |
| `--idempotency-key <key>` | reuse a key from an earlier attempt so a retry never sends twice (default: generated and printed) |
| `--failover-to-sms` | RCS only: send the text as SMS when RCS cannot be delivered |
| `--rcs-suggestions <json>` | RCS only: suggestion buttons as a JSON array, @file.json or @- |
| `--dlt-entity-id <id>` | India (TRAI DLT): Principal Entity ID |
| `--dlt-header-id <id>` | India (TRAI DLT): sender header ID |
| `--dlt-template-id <id>` | India (TRAI DLT): content template ID; the text must match it |

### vobiz streams

Test and debug the WebSocket server behind <Stream> audio streams, without placing a call

```
vobiz streams <command> [options]
```

Subcommands: [`forward`](#vobiz-streams-forward), [`test`](#vobiz-streams-test)

### vobiz streams forward

Run a local WebSocket proxy that relays a Vobiz stream to your server and logs every frame

```
vobiz streams forward [options]
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--to <ws-url>` | your stream server, e.g. ws://localhost:8080/media |
| `--port <port>` | local port to listen on (0 picks a free one; default: 8765) |
| `--host <host>` | interface to listen on |
| `--every-media` | log each media frame instead of one summary line per second |

### vobiz streams test

Act as Vobiz against your stream server: send start and media frames, check what it sends back

```
vobiz streams test <wss-url> [options]
```

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `wss-url` | yes | your stream server's URL (wss://; ws:// on localhost with --allow-insecure-url) |

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--codec <codec>` | inbound audio encoding (one of: `mulaw`, `l16`) |
| `--sample-rate <hz>` | inbound sample rate (μ-law: 8000; L16: 8000 or 16000) (one of: `8000`, `16000`) |
| `--seconds <n>` | how much audio to send, in 20 ms frames of silence (default: 3) |
| `--linger <n>` | seconds to keep listening after the last media frame (default: 1) |
| `--stream-id <id>` | streamId to put in the start frame (default: a random UUID) |
| `--call-id <id>` | callId to put in the start frame (default: a random UUID) |
| `--allow-insecure-url` | allow ws:// on localhost |


Subcommands: [`create`](#vobiz-trunks-create), [`credentials`](#vobiz-trunks-credentials), [`delete`](#vobiz-trunks-delete), [`get`](#vobiz-trunks-get), [`ip-acl`](#vobiz-trunks-ip-acl), [`list`](#vobiz-trunks-list), [`origination-uris`](#vobiz-trunks-origination-uris), [`update`](#vobiz-trunks-update)

### vobiz trunks create

Create a trunk

```
vobiz trunks create [options]
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--name <value>` | Trunk name. (required) |
| `--trunk-direction <value>` | Direction of the trunk - `inbound` or `outbound` only (a trunk is one direction, not both). (one of: `inbound`, `outbound`) |
| `--trunk-status <value>` | Trunk status - `enabled` or `disabled` (note: not `active`). (one of: `enabled`, `disabled`) |
| `--secure` | secure (--no-secure to set false) |
| `--trunk-domain <value>` | SIP domain. |
| `--transport <value>` | transport (one of: `udp`, `tcp`, `tls`) |
| `--inbound-destination <value>` | inbound destination |
| `--description <value>` | description |
| `--concurrent-calls-limit <n>` | Stored on the trunk. |
| `--cps-limit <n>` | Stored on the trunk. |
| `--credential-uuid <value>` | Attach an existing SIP credential (username / password / realm) by UUID. |
| `--ipacl-uuid <value>` | Attach an existing IP access-control list (IP-based auth) by UUID. |
| `--primary-uri-uuid <value>` | Primary origination URI UUID. |
| `--fallback-uri-uuid <value>` | Fallback origination URI UUID. |
| `--recording` | Enable call recording. (--no-recording to set false) |
| `--enable-transcription` | Auto-transcribe recordings when `recording=true`. (--no-enable-transcription to set false) |
| `--pii-redaction` | Redact PII from transcriptions. (--no-pii-redaction to set false) |
| `--pii-entity-types <value>` | Comma-separated list of entity types to redact. |
| `--webhook-url <value>` | Customer webhook for call-admission events (`CallInitiated` / `Hangup`). |
| `--webhook-method <value>` | HTTP method for the webhook callback. (default: POST) (one of: `POST`, `GET`) |
| `--recording-webhook-enabled` | Fire a `recording.completed` webhook to `webhook_url` after a recording is saved. (--no-recording-webhook-enabled to set false) |
| `--username <value>` | Deprecated - use `credential_uuid`. |
| `--password <value>` | Deprecated - use `credential_uuid`. (@file or @- for stdin keeps it out of shell history) |
| `--ip-whitelist <value>` | Deprecated - use `ipacl_uuid`. (repeatable or comma-separated) |
| `--body <json>` | full JSON body: '{…}', @file.json or @- (stdin); flags are merged on top, and unlisted keys are allowed |

### vobiz webhooks

Verify Vobiz webhook signatures and receive webhooks locally

```
vobiz webhooks <command> [options]
```

Subcommands: [`listen`](#vobiz-webhooks-listen), [`verify`](#vobiz-webhooks-verify)

### vobiz webhooks listen

Run a local webhook receiver that prints every request as JSON (and optionally forwards it)

```
vobiz webhooks listen [options]
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--port <port>` | port to listen on (0 picks a free one) |
| `--host <address>` | address to bind; use 0.0.0.0 to accept connections from other machines |
| `--forward <url>` | also send each request to this URL (e.g. your app) and relay its response back to Vobiz |
| `--secret <secret>` | check each request's signature with this secret (env: VOBIZ_WEBHOOK_SECRET) |
| `--public-url <url>` | the https URL Vobiz calls (your tunnel), needed to check voice-callback signatures |

### vobiz webhooks verify

Check a Vobiz webhook signature (voice callback V3/V2, or a body HMAC for messaging, campaign, KYC and NDNC webhooks)

```
vobiz webhooks verify [options]
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--signature <value>` | the signature header value (X-Vobiz-Signature-V3, -V2, X-Webhook-Signature or X-Vobiz-Signature) |
| `--url <callback-url>` | voice callbacks: the full URL Vobiz called (the query string is ignored) |
| `--nonce <nonce>` | voice callbacks: the X-Vobiz-Signature-V3-Nonce (or -V2-Nonce) header value |
| `--scheme <v3\|v2>` | voice callbacks: which signature version to check (default: try V3, then V2) |
| `--body <text\|@file\|@->` | body-signed webhooks: the raw request body, @file for a file, @- for stdin |
| `--secret <secret>` | signing secret: your Auth Token for voice callbacks (parent account's for -MA- headers), the subscription secret for messaging (env: VOBIZ_WEBHOOK_SECRET) |

|---|---|

### vobiz xml

Build, validate and locally serve VobizXML call-control documents

```
vobiz xml <command> [options]
```

Subcommands: [`build`](#vobiz-xml-build), [`serve`](#vobiz-xml-serve), [`validate`](#vobiz-xml-validate)

### vobiz xml build

Compose a VobizXML <Response> from flags, in the order you give them, and print it

```
vobiz xml build [options]
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--say <text>` | speak text with text-to-speech (<Speak>) |
| `--play <url>` | play an https .mp3 or .wav file (<Play>) |
| `--gather <action-url>` | collect digits or speech and post them to this https URL (<Gather>) |
| `--prompt <text>` | speak this inside the preceding --gather (up to 5 prompts) |
| `--prompt-play <url>` | play this file inside the preceding --gather |
| `--dial <destination>` | connect the caller to a number (+919876543210) or SIP URI (sip:alice@example.com) (<Dial>) |
| `--record <action-url>` | record the caller; Vobiz posts the RecordingID to this https URL (<Record>) |
| `--pause <seconds>` | wait silently for this many seconds (<Wait>) |
| `--redirect <url>` | fetch the next VobizXML from this https URL (<Redirect>; ends this document) |
| `--hangup [reason]` | end the call, optionally with reason rejected or busy (<Hangup>) |
| `--attr <key=value>` | set an attribute on the element before it, e.g. voice=MAN, numDigits=1, callerId=+918000000000 (repeatable) |

### vobiz xml serve

Serve a VobizXML file over local HTTP so you can use it as an answer URL while developing

```
vobiz xml serve <file> [options]
```

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `file` | yes | XML file to serve (re-read on every request), or - to serve stdin (read once) |

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--port <port>` | port to listen on (0 picks a free one) |
| `--host <address>` | address to bind; use 0.0.0.0 to accept connections from other machines |

### vobiz xml validate

Check a VobizXML file against the documented elements and attributes

```
vobiz xml validate <file> [options]
```

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `file` | yes | XML file to check, or - for stdin |

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--strict` | treat warnings as failures too |
